quotes.quote: I think you have to feel good about your players and the plan, and if you do, I think you go for it.
quotes.context: Asked why he keeps going for it on fourth down, after the week 16 loss at Atlanta

quotes.quote: I frickin regret my decision there at the end. I should have gone for it on fourth down.
quotes.context: After kicking a 54-yard field goal on fourth-and-4 at the Minnesota 36 with 1:14 left; the kick missed and the Vikings won 28-24

quotes.quote: I just wanted to finish with the ball in our hands. I liked where we were offensively.
quotes.context: On going for it on fourth-and-2 with 1:47 left instead of kicking, in the win at the Chargers

quotes.quote: It's easy hindsight. I get it. I get that, but I don't regret those decisions, and it's hard.
quotes.context: The day after two failed fourth-down attempts in the NFC Championship Game loss at San Francisco

quotes.quote: I just felt like we needed to end it on offense. I did not want to give that ball back.
quotes.context: On the fourth-and-1 run with 43 seconds left, tied 31-31 against Green Bay, that set up the winning field goal
